enabled.description: Enable or disable the igmpproxy service at boot.

logfile.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log to stderr (systemd: stdout).

upstream.description: Name of the upstream network interface (connected to the multicast source).

downstream.description: List of downstream (client-facing) interfaces and their associated subnets.

interface.description: Name of the downstream network interface.

subnet.description: CIDR-formatted subnet served by this interface.

allowed_groups.description: List of specific multicast groups (e.g., 239.1.1.1) allowed for forwarding on this interface. Leave empty to allow all.

excluded_groups.description: List of multicast groups explicitly excluded from forwarding.

query_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between IGMP queries from upstream interface.

threshold.description: Number of missed queries before a downstream host is considered inactive.
